name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

eligibility.landholding_limit: Must own cultivable land (no size limit currently, but originally up to 2 hectares). Institutional landholders are excluded.
eligibility.income_limit: Professionals, pensioners (over Rs 10000/month), and taxpayers are excluded.

benefits: Income support of Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2000 each.
application_process: Register online at PM-KISAN portal or visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Submit Aadhaar, land details, and bank information.
Wait for verification by state/UT nodal officers.
